name: Britannia 5050(72g)
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED (PALMOLEIN & PALM) OIL, SUGAR (18%), RAISING AGENTS [503)(ii), 500(ii) & 341(i)], IODISED SALT (0.8%), INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, YEAST, ACIDITY REGULATORS (270 & 330), EMULSIFIER (472e), NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL (VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES AND DOUGH CONDITIONER (223). (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT AND SULPHITE.
